raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied the kinship relationship, equating “maternal grandfather” with the mother’s grandfather. After identifying Harald’s mother as Princess Feodora of Denmark (daughter of Prince Harald of Denmark), the Planner incorrectly concluded that Frederick VIII (Feodora’s grandfather) was Harald’s maternal grandfather. The correct maternal grandfather is Feodora’s father, Prince Harald of Denmark.
